external_references.description: Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency. (2026, July 22). Iranian-Affiliated Cyber Actors Exploit Programmable Logic Controllers Across US Critical Infrastructure. Retrieved September 26, 2026.

objects.description: During the [2026 Iranian Water Campaign](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0065), [CyberAv3ngers](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1027) used the manufacturers’ commercial PLC programming software to push new configurations to victim hardware. These include Rockwell Automation’s [Studio Logix 5000 Designer](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9054), Schneider Electric’s [EcoStruxure Control Expert](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9056), and Siemens’ [Totally Integrated Automation (TIA) Portal](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9055). In these changes, adversaries deleted program logic, removed Add-On Instructions (AOIs) and manipulated alarm logic and HMI screens.(Citation: CISA-AA26-097A)
